public_rationale: Sightline reports that 26% of expected capacity in its tracked data-center and AI-factory pipeline slipped in 2025 [e3]. CBRE reports that primary North American data-center supply grew 36% year over year to 9,432 MW in 2025 [e4]. These records show delays alongside substantial growth, but neither matches AI-specific delivery promises to usable capacity commissioned by those deadlines [e3, e4]. They therefore neither establish nor refute the claimed mismatch through May 12, 2026 [e3, e4].
limitations: Both datasets cover broader categories than AI-only capacity.

Forecast delays for year-end 2026 do not establish missed deadlines by May 12.
The claim gives no numerical threshold for a material mismatch.
